observations: Photos show a large office copier/printer-like machine wrapped in plastic.
Brand name “SHARP” is visible on the front (photo 0 and photo 2).
Model “AR-M207” is visible on the front (photo 0 and photo 2).
No clear view of the control panel, screen, paper trays, toner/drum area, or any ports.
No photo shows it powered on or any output/copy test.

claims.evidence: No photo evidence of location/usage history; only the machine is shown wrapped.

claims.claim: The AR-M207 is packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions, delivering...
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos do not show specifications or any working demonstration.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on / may have electrical faults (common risk with used copiers shipped/handled).
risks.proof: A short video showing the machine powering on, booting to the home screen, and showing any error codes (or no errors).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed working (worst case: treat as not working until proven).

risks.risk: Paper feed issues (tray alignment, rollers, pickup/feed belts) or jams.
risks.proof: A clip showing a full copy run: load paper, start copy/print, and show the output finishing without a jam.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as likely to need service/unknown feed reliability (worst case: assume jams/needs repair).

risks.risk: Toner/drum/consumables status unknown (could be empty, worn, or leaking).
risks.proof: Photos of the toner level indicator and the inside consumables area (drum/toner compartment) plus a test page showing print quality.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as consumables not guaranteed (worst case: assume toner/drum replacement needed).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (ADF, trays, cables, manuals) or damage not visible under plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Photos of all sides and the full contents: paper trays fully pulled out, ADF (if present) shown, and a checklist of included items.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown inclusions (worst case: assume missing or damaged parts).

risks.risk: Hidden damage from shipping/handling (rollers, fuser, covers) not visible in these wrapped photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of corners/edges and any dents/scratches, plus a powered-on check for abnormal noises/smoke.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cosmetically and mechanically unverified (worst case: assume damage may require repair).

proof_requests: Video: power on + boot to the main screen (show any error codes).
Video: run a complete copy/print test (paper loaded → output produced) with no jam.
Photos: toner level indicator and inside consumables compartment.
Photos: paper trays pulled out, ADF area (if applicable), and all included accessories/cables.
response.reason: The model and brand are readable (SHARP AR-M207), but there is no proof it powers on or prints correctly; for used copiers, working status and consumables/feeding are the main price drivers and are unverified from these photos.
